title: dryopteris effusa
intro: Dryopteris effusa, commonly known as the Scaly Male Fern, is a species of fern in the Dryopteridaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the potential to treat various health issues such as inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems due to its health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an expectorant, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Dryopteris effusa contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
